dependency_edges.handoff: Monthly vectorized SST fields supply snapshots and a mean field.
Centered snapshot anomalies supply the covariance eigenproblem.
Ordered eigenvectors and eigenvalues supply projection and rank selection.
The first three historical coefficient series are extrapolated in time.
The first three fixed spatial modes enter future SST reconstruction.
Forecast time coefficients enter future SST reconstruction.
Month-specific future SST fields are thresholded by species preference.
The first-order spoilage state receives a temperature-dependent Arrhenius rate.
Fitted rate laws are inverted to obtain two threshold times.
Species-season storage times determine port-centered fishing radii.
Annual habitat envelopes are intersected with fishing radii.
Species temperature scenarios regenerate habitat envelopes.
The same critical-year search is repeated for each scenario.
The most-likely mackerel dates define the claimed relocation benefit horizon.
The storage-time equations are inverted for required refrigeration temperature.
Annual future fishing distance supplies required storage time.
Cold-chain needs motivate shipping vessels while range limits motivate a warehouse.
Forecast habitat envelopes are conceptually intersected with Danish waters.
The claimed 2035 access loss advances the cold-chain trigger to 2036.
Initial spoilage indicator values are perturbed in the sensitivity loop.
Threshold-time outputs supply the sensitivity response.
